entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Rahul Yadav
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Rahul Yadav,
learned counsel for opposite party no.4.
2.

By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has sought quashing of the First Information Report dated 08.02.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0060 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471,
406, 506 I.P.C. and Section 66D of Information and Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, Police Station Asandra, District Barabanki.
Petitioner also prays for quashing of entire criminal proceeding in the aforesaid case crime number.

1 3.

On 24.05.2024, we had passed the following order:
"Sri Rahul Yadav learned counsel has put in appearance on behalf of the informant/opposite party No.4 by filing Vakalatnama, which is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

This writ petition has been filed with a prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari for quashing the First Information Report dated 08.02.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0060 of 2024, under Sections 419,420,467,468,471,406,506 IPC and Section 66D Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, Police Station- Asandra District - Barabanki.
Submission of learned counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The dispute between the parties is purely civil in nature.
Now the petitioner and opposite party No.4/informant have entered into a compromise.
The original compromise deed dated 17.05.2024 between the parties is annexed as part of annexure No.5 to the writ petition.

Learned counsel for opposite party No.4 did not dispute the submission of counsel for the petitioner rather he supported the submission of the petitioner's counsel that the dispute between the parties has been resolved by way of compromise on 17.05.2024.
Let the petitioner and opposite party No.4 appear before the Senior Registrar of this Court on 01.06.2024 for verification of the compromise.
List this case on 05th June, 2024 showing the name of Sri Rahul Yadav, Advocate as counsel for respondent in the cause list when the case is next listed.
Learned Senior Registrar to submit his report.

In view of the aforesaid development, it is provided that till the next date of listing,
petitioner shall not be arrested in pursuance of the impugned First Information Report dated 08.02.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0060 of 2024, under Sections 419,
420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 506 IPC and Section 66D Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, Police Station- Asandra District - Barabanki."
4.
The report of the Senior Registrar of this Court dated 01.06.2024 is on record, according to which, he has verified the compromise on 01.06.2024.
The original compromise is on record which has been annexed as Annexure-5 to the writ petition.

5. According to the terms of the compromise, parties have decided to withdraw all the cases filed by them against each other including F.I.R. dated 08.02.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0060 of 2024,

2 under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 506 I.P.C. and Section 66D of Information and Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, Police Station Asandra, District Barabanki.
6. Learned counsel for the parties state that the money under the said compromise is already paid/settled between the parties.

7. Intent is clear, the informant-Heeralal S/o Rajaram Yadav, who is a signatory to the compromise,
does not want to press the FIR, therefore, no purpose would be served in allowing the proceedings even if charge sheet has been filed before the court below to go on considering the nature of the dispute.
8. Accordingly, the impugned FIR, which is the basis to serve consequential proceedings of investigation and thereafter filing of charge sheet, is hereby quashed.

Consequently, all proceedings taken consequent to the lodging of the FIR including charge sheet, if any, filed before the court below stand quashed.
9.
The writ petition is, accordingly, allowed.
10. The Senior Registrar of this Court shall communicate this order to the court concerned for correcting his record, accordingly.
11. Learned AGA shall communicate this order to the investigating officer.

Order Date :- 12.6.2024 Arti/-
[Narendra Kumar Johari,J.]
[Vivek Chaudhary,J.]
